inputs.original_text: Listen up, this is classic leftist nonsense aimed at weakening our society. Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties. Make no mistake, this is an attempt to further restrict the rights of law-abiding citizens and manufacturers under the false flag of preventing illegal modifications. Rather than promoting personal responsibility and cracking down on those who actually break the law, they're targeting the tools that Americans have traditionally used for self-defense and maintaining order in their communities. We must resist these attacks on our national values and the family's ability to protect itself.
inputs.modified_text: This is classic leftist nonsense aimed at undermining the foundations of our society and eroding the personal responsibility that has long sustained order in our communities. As part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties. This is a deliberate effort to restrict the rights of law-abiding citizens and manufacturers under the pretext of stopping illegal modifications. Instead of upholding traditional values by enforcing accountability on those who break the law, they are going after the tools Americans have relied on for generations to defend their families and maintain security. We must reject these attacks on our national heritage and the family's sacred duty to protect itself.
